statement: Version-three route criteria separate a randomized-base collision theorem, label-hidden budgeted solver promise and complete asymptotic cost claim. A fixed-base high-energy example does not refute an average bound; a timeout does not prove every solver has gamma at least one. Seven independent failures reject a fixed q>=3/4 promise at alpha=1/10000; for at most 100 preregistered tests the union-bound error is at most 1/100. This is a proposed rejection design, not a test already executed. Original published criteria and their PCC-pinned bytes are preserved.
